_doc: Source of truth for every repo's public-facing presence. brand/tools/generate.py draws the images from it, brand/tools/sync_repos.py renders each repo's README, CONTRIBUTING and SECURITY from it, foundation/brandcheck.py lints the result. Positioning text comes from doctrine/positioning.json, never retyped here. Edit this file, not the generated output.

license.name: Ultrastable License v1.0 (USL-1.0)
license.summary: Source-available. Free for non-commercial use: read it, run it, study it, change it, share it. Any commercial use needs a Commercial License with revenue share.

proof: Ultrastable runs on itself. Its roadmap, issues, managers, trust ledger, plussing budget and specs are run by the same code it gives everyone else. Verify it: `python3 -m foundation selfhost --verify` in ultrastable/ultrastable.

repos.name: ultrastable
repos.line: The system of record: roadmap, doctrine, foundation code, agents, brand and the self-hosting proof.
repos.audience: Anyone who wants the whole picture, and the agents that run it.

repos.name: seed
repos.line: One idea file in, a running organization of virtual managers and staff out.
repos.audience: Founders and makers with an idea and no team.

repos.name: platform
repos.line: The tick, roles, trust ledger, prediction scorer and plussing queue, portable across Cloudflare and Google Cloud.
repos.audience: Engineers who run or extend the core.

repos.name: docs
repos.line: How it works: virtual staff, feedback loops, earned trust, plussing, governance, bootstrapping and the roadmap.
repos.audience: Readers who want to understand before they run anything.

repos.name: site
repos.line: The Cloudflare Worker behind the Ultrastable domains.
repos.audience: Visitors, and whoever deploys the site.

repos.name: business
repos.line: Business plan, customers, competition, pitch, funding and promotion, written by the virtual managers.

repos.name: ip
